title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Tunnel Ping Pong Work Item
summary: Add a server-side tunnel context helper that echoes received WebSocket ping control messages as pong frames and leaves the tunnel open for subsequent data.
planned_changes:
- Add `Http3WebSocketTunnelContext.EchoPingAsync` to validate ping messages and write unmasked pong frames with the same payload.
- Add a loopback HTTP/3 server test that sends a masked ping, observes an unmasked pong, then sends a text message over the same tunnel and observes the handler response.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server WebSocket ping/pong test, adjacent close/handler regression tests, the RFC 9220 WebSocket parser tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: The accepted tunnel context can now reply to ping control messages with pong frames while preserving the stream for later data.
